413:t_1:3.en: ～ $$ガルガンティア船団$$, Fleet Commander's Room ～

413:t_1:5.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「You look pretty worn out.」

413:t_1:6.en:
$$リジット$$
「$$フランジ$$, the great shipowner, and his group have broken away, and the Fleet Commander is dead... If this goes on, $$ガルガンティア$$ will...」

413:t_1:7.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Get a grip, $$リジット$$. You're the Fleet Commander now.」

413:t_1:8.en:
$$リジット$$
「$$クラウン$$ should have taken the post of Fleet Commander... No one will trust someone as young as me...」

413:t_1:9.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「$$クラウン$$ is getting on in years too. Either way, we have to train someone to succeed us.」

413:t_1:11.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「...Anyway, we have a visitor. $c came to pay their respects to the Fleet Commander.」

413:t_1:13.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...I am very sorry for your loss.」

413:t_1:15.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The former Fleet Commander, $$フェアロック$$, did a great deal for us. $c is on active operations, so I have come to offer our greetings on their behalf.」

413:t_1:16.en:
$$リジット$$
「Thank you for going out of your way. $$フェアロック$$ would be glad.」

413:t_1:17.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...I have come here today for reasons besides paying my respects.」

413:t_1:19.en:
$$テッサ$$
「There are those who are targeting the $$ガルガンティア船団$$.」

413:t_1:20.en:
$$リジット$$
「No way...! I thought the $$サイデリアル$$ had been defeated...!」

413:t_1:21.en:
$$テッサ$$
「At present they are only watching, but a group separate from the $$サイデリアル$$ and the pirates is closing in on $$ガルガンティア$$.」

413:t_1:22.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Naturally, we have no intention of overlooking such lawlessness, but I would like you, Fleet Commander $$リジット$$, to steel yourself as well.」

413:t_1:23.en:
$$リジット$$
「Steel myself...? I've only just become Fleet Commander, and I've barely finished $$フェアロック$$'s funeral...」

413:t_1:25.en:
$$リジット$$
「...There's nothing I can do right now... nothing...」

413:t_1:26.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Fleet Commander $$リジット$$... How old do I look to you?」

413:t_1:28.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I am seventeen right now. And I became captain of the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ when I was even younger.」

413:t_1:29.en:
$$テッサ$$
「As you know, that is unusual even among the captains of $c.」

413:t_1:30.en:
$$リジット$$
「That's because you have a special talent...」

413:t_1:31.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I don't deny it. ...But I can't do anything alone.」

413:t_1:32.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Believe it or not, I'm terribly uncoordinated. I can't even handle a gun properly, and I trip even on flat ground with nothing on it.」

413:t_1:34.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But I have reliable subordinates and comrades.」

413:t_1:36.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「That's what she means, $$リジット$$.」

413:t_1:37.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「...I know you're working hard. That's enough.」

413:t_1:38.en:
$$リジット$$
「If it were enough, no problems would be happening...」

413:t_1:39.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Enough and perfect are different things. ...I went through a time like that myself.」

413:t_1:41.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「It was when the salvage boss first put me in charge of a job... I got all fired up and tried to shoulder everything on my own. And I ended up making a huge mistake...」

413:t_1:42.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Heh heh... So even you, $$ベローズ$$, the Salvage Master who makes crying children go quiet, had a time like that.」

413:t_1:43.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「And what about you, Captain Klutz?」

413:t_1:44.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Well... I have made mistakes. I can't tell you about them here, though.」

413:t_1:46.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「$$ピニオン$$ laughed his head off at me back then... He said, 'You can't see what's around you. That's the same as not trusting your crew.'」

413:t_1:48.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「It's not enough to just handle everything alone. So...」

413:t_1:49.en:
$$リジット$$
「But Fleet Commander $$フェアロック$$ did it...」

413:t_1:50.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Is that so? Whenever I met the former Fleet Commander, you were always at his side.」

413:t_1:51.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Even that old man relied on you.」

413:t_1:52.en:
$$リジット$$
「Fleet Commander $$フェアロック$$ did...」

413:t_1:53.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「What you have to do is think about who to rely on for what, so that things go well.」

413:t_1:55.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Exactly. If you become the fleet's brain, others can serve as its hands, feet and heart.」

413:t_1:56.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「You'd put the salvage I haul up to good use... I'd like to leave the ships in the hands of someone like that.」

413:t_1:62.en:
$$フランジ$$
「...In short, we passed as members of this fleet.」

413:t_1:63.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Looks like it. In my case, getting the treasure fixed up so it works is what counts.」

413:t_1:64.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Apparently I've got talent. They said I might even build new weapons someday.」

413:t_1:65.en:
$$フランジ$$
「Don't be fooled, $$ピニオン$$. This fleet only wants to absorb us.」

413:t_1:67.en:
$$オンデリア$$
「That is right. That is exactly what will make you happy as well.」

413:t_1:69.en:
$$オンデリア$$
「Blessings to those who follow providence. And God's hammer to those who defy it.」

413:t_1:70.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Hey, hey...! We're not looking to pick a fight here.」

413:t_1:72.en:
$$オンデリア$$
「They are going to God.」

413:t_1:73.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「What are you talking about?! Tie someone hand and foot and drop them in the sea, and they can only die!」

413:t_1:74.en:
$$オンデリア$$
「To offer the utmost gratitude, they die for the living... For the salvation of humanity, they bathe in eternal glory.」

413:t_1:75.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「You've got to be kidding...」

413:t_1:76.en:
$$フランジ$$
「So this... is how this fleet does things...」

413:t_1:77.en:
$$オンデリア$$
「Blessings to those who follow providence. And God's hammer to those who defy it. ...Kneel.」

413:t_1:79.en:
$$オンデリア$$
「I bestow my blessing. New servant of $$クーゲル$$.」

413:t_1:80.en:
$$オンデリア$$
「In the name of providence, may you devote your body and strength to the great cause.」

413:t_1:82.en:
$$オンデリア$$
「$$ピニオン$$ of the Misty Sea...」

413:t_1:84.en:
$$オンデリア$$
「The Giant of Thunder will soon take flight to spread the enlightenment of God's will... You will assist in that.」
